headline: Iran's Mehr News Agency published the supposed 14 MOU clauses. $24 billion in frozen funds released in two tranches. Oil sanctions suspended. Naval blockade lifted within 30 days. U.S. commits to withdrawing forces, non-interference, and no new sanctions during talks. Immediate ceasefire on all fronts including Lebanon. Hormuz reopens under Iranian arrangements. Iran reaffirms its NPT commitment. 60-day window for a final nuclear deal and full sanctions removal. U.S. and allies must present $300 billion in reconstruction plans. Iran's missile program and resistance group support removed from the agenda entirely. No talks begin until preconditions are met. Final agreement requires UNSC resolution. - Mehr News Agency
